title: Canonical objectwise single vertical window identification
statement: For an abelian category C, q in N and K a nonnegative cochain complex, construct a specific isomorphism from its single smart window to the single complex on H^q(K). Its degree-q component is the canonical surviving-degree isomorphism of lem-sp-vertical-window-degree-iso; all other components are zero.

source.place: Proof steps 1 and 2, canonical single-window comparison

proof.text: The upper truncation remains strictly supported above q and below q, so each term outside q is zero. The canonical surviving-degree identification defines morphisms to and from the single complex via mkHomToSingle and mkHomFromSingle. The differential conditions and inverse equations are checked degreewise.
